notes: Two delivery mechanisms: (1) Hooks API — register a hook against an entity+action pair (e.g. Client:CREATE, Loan:REPAYMENT). Fineract POSTs the API response as the body plus headers X-Mifos-Entity, X-Mifos-Action and X-Mifos-Platform-TenantId. (2) Business Events pipeline — Fineract publishes events like ClientCreated / LoanApproved / LoanDisbursed / SavingsDeposit to Kafka or ActiveMQ JMS. Both are disabled by default in vanilla deployments; the Hooks system is the simpler turn-on, the Kafka pipeline is the production-scale option. Polling with date filters (activatedOnDateFrom, disbursedOnDateFrom) is the universal fallback.

triggers.name: New Client Created
triggers.description: Fires when a new client (individual or entity) is onboarded. Register a hook with entity=Client, action=CREATE. Fineract also publishes a `ClientCreated` Business Event for Kafka/JMS consumers.
triggers.mechanismDetail: Programmable webhook (Fineract Hooks: Client:CREATE) — also Kafka `ClientCreated`

triggers.name: Client Updated
triggers.description: Fires when a client's data is updated. Register a hook with entity=Client, action=UPDATE.

triggers.name: New Loan Application
triggers.description: Fires when a new loan application is created (submitted, pre-approval). Register a hook with entity=Loan, action=CREATE.

triggers.name: Loan Approved
triggers.description: Fires when a loan is approved by an authorised user. Register a hook with entity=Loan, action=APPROVE; also published as the `LoanApproved` Business Event on Kafka/JMS.

triggers.name: Loan Disbursed
triggers.description: Fires when loan funds are released to the borrower. Register a hook with entity=Loan, action=DISBURSE; also published as `LoanDisbursed` Business Event on Kafka/JMS. The Kafka path is recommended for production volume.

triggers.name: Loan Repayment Made
triggers.description: Fires when a repayment transaction is recorded against a loan. Register a hook with entity=Loan, action=REPAYMENT (one of the two events confirmed working with the SMS Bridge template). Also published as `LoanRepayment` on Kafka/JMS.

triggers.name: Loan Repayment Failed
triggers.description: Fires when a scheduled repayment goes overdue / falls into arrears. No dedicated 'repayment failed' hook event is confirmed in public docs. Fallback: poll loans with `overdue=true` / arrears filters on a schedule.
triggers.mechanismDetail: Polling with cursor (loans with arrears filter)

triggers.name: Loan Written Off
triggers.description: Fires when a loan is written off. Write-off is a loan action but not confirmed in public docs as a specific hook event. Fallback: poll loan status for write-off transitions.

triggers.name: New Savings Account
triggers.description: Fires when a new savings account is created. Register a hook with entity=Savings, action=CREATE.

triggers.name: Savings Deposit Made
triggers.description: Fires when a deposit is recorded on a savings account. Deposit is a savings action; the specific hook event is not explicitly confirmed in public docs. Fallback: poll savings transactions; also published on Kafka as `SavingsDeposit`.

triggers.name: Savings Withdrawal Made
triggers.description: Fires when a withdrawal is recorded on a savings account. Same uncertainty as deposit. Fallback: poll savings transactions.

triggers.name: Charge Paid
triggers.description: Fires when a charge is paid on a savings account. Register a hook with entity=Savings, action=PAYCHARGE. The `paycharge` action is documented as generating webhook payloads.

triggers.name: New Share Account
triggers.description: Fires when a new share account is opened. No confirmed hook event in public docs; poll the share accounts API with a date filter.

triggers.name: Fixed Deposit Matured
triggers.description: Fires when a fixed deposit reaches its maturity date. No confirmed hook event; poll fixed deposit accounts by `maturityDate` on a schedule.

triggers.name: Close of Business Day Completed
triggers.description: Fires when the COB batch job finishes for a business date. Published as a Kafka business event (`CloseOfBusiness` / similar) — recommended trigger for end-of-day reconciliation and reporting.
